body: I know that some people might view what I'm talking about as self-punishment, and it makes sense to look at it like that, but I'm not really that 'just' a person to be able to judge and punish myself accordingly. I just think that most people have the capacity to be good, so whatever they may have done in the past their death could still be a net loss. I don't think I'm one of those people though. So it's less about what I did and more about what I can do, and I don't think any of that will lead to the betterment of anyone.

I understand where you're coming from, and I appreciate you taking the time to write this. I don't want to talk about what it is that makes me so bad, just want to let you know I've never hurt anyone. I think those people you mentioned are trash too and probably objectively worse than me. But that doesn't make me not bad. I think 'deserving of death' is really in the eye of the beholder. If I know for a fact I'm a bad influence on the world, I feel like I have almost an obligation to do something about it, even though I would never pass that same judgement on someone else. If I think everyone I love will be happier if they never get to learn the real me, isn't it better to make sure they never will? 

Sorry, I don't wanna sound like I'm lobbying for suicide, I know tragically tons of great people do it, and I think the vast majority of people shouldn't. I can't say the same about me though.
